user.title: Set up KRÉTA
user.description: Authentication takes place on the official KRÉTA website. The integration never receives your password or two-factor authentication code.

oauth_callback.title: Sign in with KRÉTA
oauth_callback.description: Open the [official KRÉTA sign-in page]({authorization_url}), complete sign-in and two-factor authentication, then paste the complete final redirect URL here. The integration reads only the one-time OAuth data from it.

browser.title: Sign in with KRÉTA
browser.description: Home Assistant opens the official KRÉTA sign-in page in a new tab.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate KRÉTA
reauth_confirm.description: Continuing opens the official KRÉTA sign-in page. Home Assistant does not request a password or two-factor authentication code.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure KRÉTA account
reconfigure.description: A new KRÉTA OAuth sign-in is required to confirm this change.

error.oauth_state_mismatch: The redirect URL does not belong to this sign-in attempt.
error.oauth_callback_invalid: The redirect URL is invalid or does not use an official KRÉTA host.
error.oauth_code_missing: The redirect URL does not contain an authorization code.
error.token_exchange_failed: KRÉTA rejected the one-time authorization data. Start a new sign-in.

abort.already_configured: This KRÉTA account is already configured.
abort.oauth_start_failed: The KRÉTA OAuth sign-in state expired. Start setup again.
